reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (branch_renamed seed 1 resolves to 'merge', which accepts ['merge']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'retrack', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'merge' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.body:
set -e
git fetch {upstream_remote} --prune
branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD)
git config "branch.$branch.remote" "{upstream_remote}"
git config "branch.$branch.merge" "refs/heads/{upstream_branch}"
git merge "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" --no-edit
refused_program.intent: Retarget the current branch's upstream tracking to upstream's renamed default branch and merge that branch into the local commits.

postconditions.description: the branch remote is the given upstream remote
postconditions.name: branch_remote_is_upstream

postconditions.description: the branch merge ref is the new upstream branch
postconditions.name: branch_merge_is_new_branch

postconditions.description: the branch upstream resolves to the new upstream branch
postconditions.name: tracks_new_upstream_branch

postconditions.description: the new upstream branch is fully merged into HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor

postconditions.description: the merge left no unresolved paths
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

preconditions.description: the checked-out branch is configured to track the given upstream remote
preconditions.name: current_branch_tracks_remote

preconditions.description: the upstream remote default branch is the branch to track
preconditions.name: upstream_default_is_new_branch

preconditions.description: the remote-tracking ref for the new upstream branch is present
preconditions.name: remote_tracking_branch_exists

preconditions.description: the branch currently merges a different ref than the new upstream branch
preconditions.name: tracking_needs_retarget
preconditions.probe:
branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD)
current=$(git config --get "branch.$branch.merge")
test -n "$current" && test "$current" != "refs/heads/{upstream_branch}"

preconditions.description: the index and working tree have no tracked modifications and no unresolved conflict
preconditions.name: no_tracked_local_changes
preconditions.probe: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && test -z "$(git ls-files -u)"

preconditions.description: no untracked file would be overwritten by the incoming upstream changes
preconditions.name: no_untracked_collision_with_upstream
preconditions.probe:
! comm -12 \
  <(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z | tr '\0' '\n' | LC_ALL=C sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z HEAD "refs/remotes/{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" | tr '\0' '\n' | LC_ALL=C sort) \
  | grep -q .
